passage.label: as for man when Lord tries him generous favors says Lord honored me; tries restricts provision says Lord humiliated me; No do not honor orphan; not encourage one another feed poor; consume inheritance devouring altogether; love wealth immense love

arabicExcerpts.text: فَأَمَّا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكۡرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَكۡرَمَنِ
وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ

mainSubject.label: Man's flawed response to divine trial: claiming honour when given generously but humiliation when provision is restricted; the correction that they neither honour the orphan nor encourage feeding the poor, consuming inheritance by devouring it altogether and loving wealth with immense love

subordinateSubjects.label: Man claiming honour when his Lord tests him with generosity and favour
But declaring humiliation when tested with restricted provision
The rebuke: you do not honour the orphan
Nor encourage one another to feed the poor

commandsAndProhibitions.description: You do not honour the orphan — a social failure condemned.
You consume inheritance devouring it altogether.

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: Misreading divine generosity as honour and restriction as humiliation
Wealth loved with immense attachment overriding social obligations

socialEconomicCivilisational.label: Orphan dishonoured and mutual encouragement to feed the poor absent
Inheritance consumed by devouring it altogether without rightful distribution

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the Lord-is-in-observation declaration (14) before the human-trial-response block opens (15); P2 ends with the immense-love-of-wealth diagnosis (20) before the eschatological earth-levelling begins (21); P3 covers the six-verse Day scene ending with the unmatched-punishment verdict (21-26); P4 runs through the four-verse address to the reassured soul (27-30).
